ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AAA Technologies Limited announced a significant board overhaul, prompted by a change in ownership/control following a Share Purchase Agreement, which led to the immediate resignation of its Managing Director and an Independent Director. To address these departures, the company appointed a new Executive Director and a new Independent Director, necessitating the reconstitution of all key board committees. This signals a clear shift in leadership and strategic direction, with the full implications of the new ownership yet to be detailed.
